odc_type: incorrect timezone offset handling during DST transition
observation_summary: DateTime objects exhibit an incorrect timezone offset after calling field-modification methods (e.g., withHourOfDay) during a DST transition.
reasoning_summary: The failing tests consistently show that when performing field-based modifications (like withHourOfDay, withMinuteOfHour, etc.) on a DateTime object during a Daylight Saving Time (DST) transition, the library incorrectly switches the timezone offset. The expected behavior is to maintain the original offset if the resulting local time is valid within that offset, but the implementation is prematurely or incorrectly recalculating the offset based on the new local time, leading to an unexpected shift in the UTC-offset component of the timestamp.
